capabilities: Convert a note or selection to HTML using Obsidian's markdown renderer
Clean HTML by stripping attributes, classes, and empty paragraphs
Embed internal images up to 128KB as base64 strings
Copy a note as plain text without frontmatter
Configure which attributes and classes are kept
disambiguation: Not a full-page HTML exporter; the README states it doesn't generate a complete HTML page and only copies content to the clipboard.
extras: The Copy as Text feature is described as a minor side function. The README warns that non-configured CSS classes are removed and that pasting HTML on Android requires using the context menu rather than the keyboard paste option.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy a rendered note as HTML to the clipboard for pasting into rich text editors.

relations.evidence: Should work with all other plugins that add content to your note, like DataView

summary: Clipboard export tool that converts a note or selection to cleaned HTML using Obsidian's renderer, or copies it as plain text.
